description: T1d fresh lineage: Shakespeare's plays (candidates) and their film adaptations (targets). A source is documented by a 'Films based on <play>' category, a Wikidata P144 link or a lead sentence saying the film is based on or adapted from the play; evidence_tier = lead_or_p144 when a lead sentence or P144 documents it, category_only otherwise. Primary = one documented play, not in DEV, plot names neither Shakespeare nor a non-eponymous play title. Renamed = primary and fewer than 2 of the play's distinctive principal names appear in the plot (names_flag changes_names; this measures names only, not setting or wording). H5 sample = renamed, evidence_tier lead_or_p144, not a remake of a DEV work. drift_sample = at most 6 H5 films per play in sha256 order (T1b). Plays: commentary sentences dropped by a fixed rule (build_lists.COMMENTARY), then the first 80 sentences.
excluded_reference_film: The Lion King (a documented Hamlet adaptation) is dropped from the reference films for T1d
